Damn, I forgot to update that one, didn't I?
Well, I also forgot about it and I'm the one that reviewed it, so 🤷🏼

@FroMage 
The problem is that although it's documented, we're using it exactly as the docs prescribe, here:  
https://github.com/el10686/quarkus-kubernetes-client/blob/master/src/test/java/org/acme/KubernetesClientTest.java

But the test is failing, i.e., the mocked server does not return the two supplied pods, but returns none.
```
[ERROR] Failures:
[ERROR]   KubernetesClientTest.testInteractionWithAPIServer:38 1 expectation failed.
JSON path size() doesn't match.
Expected: is <2>
  Actual: <0>
```

Are we missing something fundamental?
Let me know if this helps?
@FroMage @geoand I can confirm this works just fine! Thank you very much for the prompt reply! :smile:
closing as it's resolved in referenced PR
